warning: Red: areas the Michigan DNR rules close: state park lands the DNR shows as closed to hunting, the Boardman Lake and River reach, Mud Lake / Lake St. Helen, the Au Train basin refuge (entry too, to Nov 10) and two small Huron County parcels. Amber: special rules: the Allegan County and Muskegon County Wastewater goose units and the permit-draw managed waterfowl areas. State parks are closed to hunting unless the Order opens them (portions of 26 are open); several close Sept 1-7 or 1-15. Other closed areas are in Chapter 8 of the Wildlife Conservation Order. Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer). Strips along rivers and the Huron County lot are approximate (labelled).
source: Michigan DNR 2026 Waterfowl Hunting Regulations Summary; Wildlife Conservation Order sections 8.7, 8.13, 8.14, 12.702, 12.703; DNR Parks Hunting Land Boundary; DNR Wildlife Property Boundary.

areas.n: Boardman Lake - closed to ducks, geese and mergansers
areas.d: WCO 8.13: closed to taking ducks, geese and mergansers Sept 1 - Dec 15, on the waters of Boardman Lake and those portions of the Boardman River north of the Airport Road bridge and south of the Eighth Street bridge (sections 10, 11, 14, 15, T27N R11W, Grand Traverse County). Outline: USGS NHD lake.

areas.n: Boardman River - closed to ducks, geese and mergansers
areas.d: WCO 8.13 (Sept 1 - Dec 15): the Boardman River between the Airport Road bridge and the Eighth Street bridge. APPROXIMATE: a narrow strip along the OpenStreetMap river centerline; the Order gives no width.

areas.n: Lake St. Helen - closed to public waterfowl hunting
areas.d: Michigan DNR 2026 waterfowl summary: Mud Lake, Lake St. Helen and the South Branch of the Au Sable River connecting these two lakes (Roscommon County) are closed to public waterfowl hunting. Outline: USGS NHD lake.

areas.n: Mud Lake (Roscommon County) - closed to public waterfowl hunting
areas.d: Michigan DNR 2026 waterfowl summary: Mud Lake, Lake St. Helen and the South Branch of the Au Sable River connecting these two lakes (Roscommon County) are closed to public waterfowl hunting. Outline: USGS NHD lake.

areas.n: Au Train basin waterfowl refuge - entry and hunting prohibited
areas.d: WCO 8.14: from Sept 1 through Nov 10 no person may enter or take any animal in the Au Train basin waterfowl refuge (Alger County; sections 25, 35, 36 T45N R21W and 30, 31 T45N R20W). Built from the Order’s section lines on the DNR PLSS layer; the first leg (an unnamed road and USFS road 2234 from the center of section 30 to the southeast corner of section 31) is drawn as a straight link.

areas.n: Huron County closed parcel - south 600 ft of section 29 (T16N R9E)
areas.d: WCO 8.7(2): no person may take any animal from the south 600 feet, except the southerly 35 feet, of section 29, T16N R9E, Huron County, as posted. Drawn from the DNR PLSS section.

areas.n: Huron County closed parcel - east part of government lot 3, section 21 (T16N R9E)
areas.d: WCO 8.7(1): no person may take any animal from the part of government lot 3, section 21, T16N R9E, east of a private road that enters its south side about 1,500 feet west of the section’s southeast corner and runs north (except land deeded to the state), as posted. APPROXIMATE: the DNR PLSS layer has no government lots, so this is a rectangle 1,500 ft wide and 1,320 ft deep at the section’s southeast corner.

areas.n: Allegan County goose management unit
areas.d: WCO 12.702: geese Sept 1-30, Oct 17 - Nov 4 and Dec 19 - Feb 14 (the rest of the South Zone: Sept 1-30, Oct 17 - Dec 13, Dec 26 - Jan 3, Feb 6-15). Includes the Fennville Farm unit of the Allegan State Game Area (drawings Wed, Sat and Sun Dec 19 - Feb 14; closed to goose hunting Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri; self-registration outside the drawing dates). WCO 3.415b also closes the Highbanks, Fennville Farm and Bravo units Sept 1-7, which the DNR summary does not mention. Routed on the roads in the Order: I-196, 136th Ave, M-40, 108th Ave, 46th St, 109th Ave.

areas.n: Muskegon County Wastewater System goose unit
areas.d: WCO 12.703 and the DNR summary: geese Oct 20 - Dec 19 only (the rest of the South Zone has a September season; this unit is closed to it). Dry agricultural fields at the Muskegon County Resource Recovery Center, hunting by free drawing (Tue and Sat 5:30 a.m., Thu and Sat 11 a.m.), closed Thanksgiving Day; ducks follow the South Zone. Outline: DNR wastewater system management area (the Order describes about 11,000 acres, as posted; the DNR summary says 5,700 acres of fields).

areas.n: Fish Point SWA - managed waterfowl area (permit draw)
areas.d: Michigan Wetland Wonders: hunting by free permit drawing in set zones. Tuscola Co. Free daily drawings at 5:30 a.m.; reserved hunts Oct 3-4 (youth p.m. Oct 3). From the 2026 opening weekends the area is closed to waterfowl hunting on Sundays and Mondays and draws are one a day, Tuesday to Saturday (DNR release 30 Jul 2026). Shot no larger than BBB (WCO 3.414). Outline: DNR Wildlife Property Boundary.

areas.n: Nayanquing Point SWA - managed waterfowl area (permit draw)
areas.d: Michigan Wetland Wonders: hunting by free permit drawing in set zones. Bay Co. Free daily drawings at 5:30 a.m.; reserved hunts Oct 3-4. Closed to waterfowl hunting Sundays and Mondays after the opening weekends; one draw a day Tuesday to Saturday (DNR release 30 Jul 2026). Shot no larger than BBB. Outline: DNR Wildlife Property Boundary.

areas.n: Pointe Mouillee SGA - managed waterfowl area (permit draw)
areas.d: Michigan Wetland Wonders: hunting by free permit drawing in set zones. Wayne and Monroe Cos. Drawings Sundays and Thursdays 5:30 a.m. and Sundays and Tuesdays 11 a.m.; reserved hunts Oct 17-18. Thursday morning permits are valid until the close of shooting hours. Shot no larger than No. 1 (WCO 3.414). Outline: DNR Wildlife Property Boundary.

areas.n: Shiawassee River SGA - managed waterfowl area (permit draw)
areas.d: Michigan Wetland Wonders: hunting by free permit drawing in set zones. Saginaw Co. Free daily drawings; reserved hunts Oct 17-18. Closed to waterfowl hunting Sundays and Mondays after the opening weekends; one draw a day Tuesday to Saturday (DNR release 30 Jul 2026). Shot no larger than BBB. (Shiawassee National Wildlife Refuge next door is federal: see the Refuges layer.) Outline: DNR Wildlife Property Boundary.

areas.n: St. Clair Flats SWA - managed waterfowl area (permit draw)
areas.d: Michigan Wetland Wonders: hunting by free permit drawing in set zones. St. Clair Co. (Harsens Island). Free daily drawings; reserved hunts Oct 17-18. Closed to waterfowl hunting Sundays and Mondays after the opening weekends at the Harsens Island Unit; one draw a day Tuesday to Saturday (DNR release 30 Jul 2026). Shot no larger than No. 1. Outline: DNR Wildlife Property Boundary.
